name: RetailSync Executive Dashboard
description: Real-time retail analytics: revenue, products, customers. Data source: Databricks SQL Warehouse (retailsync.gold.*).

views.name: executive_overview
views.title: Executive Overview
views.query: SELECT sales_date, orders_count, revenue, avg_order_value FROM retailsync.gold.daily_sales_bi ORDER BY sales_date

views.name: product_analytics
views.title: Product Analytics
views.query: SELECT product_name, category, units_sold, revenue FROM retailsync.gold.product_sales_bi ORDER BY revenue DESC

views.name: customer_360
views.title: Customer 360
views.query: SELECT first_name, last_name, city, orders_count, lifetime_spend, avg_basket FROM retailsync.gold.customer_360_bi ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC

refresh.method: scheduled refresh via Databricks SQL Warehouse
